# `Browser.FilePicker`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.FilePicker — open a native file picker and read the chosen file
as a `data:` URL, over `Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism: an outbound `JsCmd`
opens the native `<input type="file">` dialog, and an inbound `JsMsg` carries
the result — a `PickedFile` record or a typed denial/cancellation. Both cross
the same seal codec and fail-closed port discipline as every other port; there
is no second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses `js-port:file`
(import-derived, keyed on the canonical `Ipe.Browser.FilePicker` path prefix
via `WebCapability::for_browser_module`, alias-immune); only the top-level
app's `[capabilities] accepts` set can grant it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.FilePicker.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound
    ADTs and the raw `Ipe.Ffi.Js` wiring.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `pickFile` and `pickImage` each
    return a `Task Error PickedFile` via the correlated port→Task bridge; a
    user cancellation or a host denial resolves to a typed `Err`. The inbound
    `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: every variant becomes either an `Ok` or a typed
    `Err`, never a silently dropped frame.

## `PickedFile`

A file returned by the picker: the filename, its MIME type, and the full
file contents encoded as a `data:` URL (e.g. `data:image/png;base64,...`).

## `pickFile`

```ipe
pickFile : Task Error PickedFile
```

`pickFile` — open a general-purpose file picker dialog, as a
`Task Error PickedFile`.

Uses the correlated port→Task bridge (`Js.request`). The served JS handler
opens an `<input type="file">` with no MIME filter, reads the selected file
via `FileReader.readAsDataURL`, and resolves the `Task` with the result. A
user cancellation resolves to `Err` (cancelled); a host denial or an absent
File API resolves to the corresponding typed `Err`.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:file`; the app must grant it with
`accepts = [ JsPort File ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `pickImage`

```ipe
pickImage : Task Error PickedFile
```

`pickImage` — open an image-only file picker dialog, as a
`Task Error PickedFile`.

Identical to `pickFile` but the served JS handler applies an `accept:
"image/*"` MIME filter so the platform file chooser pre-filters to images.
The resolved `PickedFile` is the same shape; `mime` carries the actual MIME
type of the chosen file.

## `picks`

```ipe
picks : (Result Error PickedFile -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`picks toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame
is dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a
`Result Error PickedFile`.
